outcomeNote: A one-clause mishna with no interlocutors; its gemara lies beyond this packet.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַשּׁוֹחֵט בְּשַׁבָּת וּבְיוֹם הַכִּיפּוּרִים, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמִּתְחַיֵּיב בְּנַפְשׁוֹ – שְׁחִיטָתוֹ כְּשֵׁרָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who slaughters» an animal «on Shabbat or on Yom Kippur, although he is liable to» receive the «death» penalty, «his slaughter is valid.»

moves.summary: the mishna validates the slaughter even though the act itself is a capital transgression
